basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: GTM Engineer, Applied AI | Ships AI Into Revenue Systems | HubSpot + Salesforce + Agents | MBA
basics.summary: Applied AI engineer who lives inside the revenue stack. At LumApps I ship the AI-native GTM systems the JD describes: multi-agent workflows over HubSpot, Salesforce and Pendo that 2x outbound conversions and forecast $1M/quarter. I own the data-integrity layer behind them (temporal knowledge graph unifying 5+ silos, freshness checks, evals, cost telemetry). Prior 6 years at Beekeeper covered GenAI demo systems from Salesforce data, LLM pipelines, and co-owning GTM launches with Sales and PM. MBA-trained (Quantic, 93.2%), founder mindset, comfortable being the single accountable owner without a playbook.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built and shipped AI-native GTM systems: multi-agent workflows over HubSpot, Salesforce and Pendo (Python + LangGraph + Google ADK on GCP) that 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, save reps 2 to 3 hours/day, forecast $4M/quarter in opportunities and $1M/quarter in revenue.

Own the data-integrity layer: designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j unifying 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware source. Freshness checks flag stale fields; ingestion runs event-driven on Pub/Sub.
Own monitoring on top: eval pipelines (LangSmith), cost-per-request telemetry, tool-selection tuning, on-call for global production. Nothing in this stack needs a human to check by hand.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Built GenAI demo system for Sales: prompts fed by Salesforce data auto-generate per-customer pitch content. Improved demo speed and close rates on real deals. Applied AI to a classic RevOps problem end-to-end.

Co-owned GTM launches with Sales, PM, and Customer Success (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle. Employee Referral System became top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR).
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house Python + OpenAI pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Diagnosed the recurring spend, decided to automate, built the fix.
Ran observability and on-call for global production (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io, Langfuse): dashboards, alerting, pipeline health. Fix-it procedures documented so a break did not require me.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC investment decisions. Presented consultant-style recommendations to investment committees.
Advised portfolio founders on GTM system choices, AI adoption, and building revenue infrastructure that scales.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for EPFL spin-off drone delivery. Shipped end-to-end platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) powering 500+ real-world deliveries. Closed Unilever partnership and CES Las Vegas showcase.
Owned the full system as single accountable owner: architecture, integrations, data workflows, on-call, and the customer conversations behind them.
